about_the_game:
The Rosenbauer HEROS Titan DLC includes the high-performance firefighting helmet HEROS Titan, designed and manufactured by Rosenbauer. This is a state-of-the-art helmet that combines a modern design with optimal protection and maximum comfort during every shift.

This DLC includes:

- The HEROS Titan helmet from Rosenbauer
